name: WikiANN: Cross-lingual Name Tagging and Linking for 282 Languages
description: WikiANN (commonly evaluated as PAN-X in massively multilingual NER benchmarks) is a landmark multilingual named entity recognition and linking corpus covering 282 languages. Automatically constructed from Wikipedia cross-lingual links, article redirects, and anchor texts, WikiANN provides sentence-level sequence labeling for Person (PER), Organization (ORG), and Location (LOC) entity spans. Standardized into balanced train, development, and test splits by Rahimi et al. (2019), it serves as the foundational testbed for zero-shot and few-shot cross-lingual named entity transfer.
